crystal_phase.Ni-Pt/Al2O3: Ni phase (JCPDS No. 04-0850), Pt phase (JCPDS No. 04-0802)

Proof in the paper: Fig. 1 shows the diffraction patterns of reduced bimetallic catalysts. It can be seen that all samples contain Al2O3 phase (JCPDS No. 79-1558) at 2θ= 37.7°, 45.8°, and 66.8°. Moreover, diffraction peaks at 44.3°and 51.7°, which are indexed to the planes (111) and (200) of Ni phase (JCPDS No. 04-0850), respectively, are presented in all samples. Specifically, the Ni (200) plane is employed to estimate the crystal size (see Table 1). For these bimetallic catalysts, a new peak at 39° is detected for NiPt/Al2O3 and Pt-Ni/Al2O3 catalyst, attributing to Pt (111) plane (JCPDS No. 04-0802).
